reason: Provides network search for Deepseek Harness sessions through configured model providers, with optional URL content retrieval on compatible Responses APIs.

summaries.zh: 通过兼容的模型提供商服务为 Deepseek Harness 会话提供网络搜索，并在支持的接口上检索网页内容。
summaries.en: Provides network search for Deepseek Harness sessions through compatible model providers, with webpage content retrieval on supported APIs.

capabilities: Uses a model provider's server-side web search capability
May retrieve and search content from URLs through providers supporting the OpenAI Responses API
Sends requests to configured external model provider endpoints using configured credentials
